request: Formatters (src-tauri/src/formatter.rs) are often wrapper scripts that start the real tool; on timeout only the wrapper is killed and the tool keeps running. Give fn run a timeout parameter: run(cmd: Command, input: String, ok_codes: &[i32], timeout: Duration) -> Result<String, String>. Start the formatter in its own process group on Unix and on timeout kill the whole tree (command_tool::kill_tree), returning Err("timed out after 1 s") for a 1 s timeout, without waiting on pipes the killed children held. Also convert the output to the file's own line endings, and match the project root ignoring case on Windows and macOS.
